paragraphs: Somos un hostel chico en San Salvador de Jujuy con mucho corazón. En Casa NUNA hotel vas a encontrar pileta, parrilla, cocina, WiFi y la mejor onda para que tu viaje sea inolvidable.

testimonials.author: Aylen Quispe
testimonials.text: Una experiencia increíble de principio a fin. Un lugar súper hermoso, cálido y acogedor, ideal para descansar y disfrutar de Tilcara. La atención es espectacular, siempre atentos a cada detalle y haciendo que uno se sienta como en casa. Sin dudas, volvería a elegir Hotel Casa Nuna y lo recomiendo al 100%. ¡Gracias por tan linda estadía!

testimonials.author: Aylen Gimenez
testimonials.text: Excelente atención por parte de Angélica y las chicas, súper amables y atentas. Ubicación inmejorable. Ideal para desconectar sintiéndote como en casa ❤️

testimonials.author: Emiliana Velazquez
testimonials.text: Lo único lindo y destacable es la decoración , es nuevo y muy lindo pero, la calefacción solamente de 8 de la mañana a las 6 de la tarde, llegamos cansados 16 hs era una heladera, no tiene bidet,  la ducha cuesta mucho que llegue el agua…

testimonials.author: Morena Martinez
testimonials.text: Es un lugar hermoso. Desde el momento en que llegas, transmite una gran sensación de paz, tanto por el entorno como por la calidez de las personas que te reciben. La atención es excelente y hacen que la estadía sea aún más agradable.…

faq.answer: A pocas cuadras, caminando llegás en 5 minutos.

about.title: The story of Casa NUNA hotel.
paragraphs: Welcome to Casa NUNA hotel, right in the heart of San Salvador de Jujuy. Our hostel has a pool, BBQ, full kitchen and spaces to relax. We're a small hostel with great vibes, where every traveler is welcome.

location.description: San Salvador de Jujuy. The best place to stay in the area.

faq.question: Is there parking?
faq.answer: Yes, we have free parking on the property.

faq.question: What time can I check in and out?
faq.answer: We're flexible with times. Drop us a message and we'll work it out.

faq.question: Can I pay by card?
faq.answer: Ask us, we have several payment options to make it easy for you.

faq.question: Is there a kitchen to use?
faq.answer: Yes, a full kitchen so you can cook whatever you want.

testimonials.author: Aylen Quispe
testimonials.text: An incredible experience from start to finish. A super beautiful, warm and cozy place, ideal to rest and enjoy Tilcara. The attention is spectacular, always attentive to every detail and making you feel at home. Without a doubt, I would choose Hotel Casa Nuna again and I recommend it 100%. Thank you for such a nice stay!

testimonials.author: Aylen Gimenez
testimonials.text: Excellent service from Angélica and the girls, super friendly and attentive. Unbeatable location. Ideal to disconnect while feeling at home ❤️

testimonials.author: Emiliana Velazquez
testimonials.text: The only nice and notable thing is the decoration, it is new and very nice but, the heating only from 8 in the morning to 6 in the afternoon, we arrived tired at 4 p.m. It was a refrigerator, it does not have a bidet, the shower costs a lot to get the water...

testimonials.author: Morena Martinez
testimonials.text: It's a beautiful place. From the moment you arrive, it conveys a great feeling of peace, both due to the environment and the warmth of the people who welcome you. The service is excellent and they make the stay even more pleasant.…
